boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Norwich University
boards.description: A source-checked set of under-21-safe food and grocery stops in Northfield and nearby Barre/Montpelier with evening availability.

cards.title: Pizza Pickup on North Main
cards.subtitle: 15 N Main St, Northfield
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to confirm the day’s closing time, then place a carryout or delivery order before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A Northfield pizza option with official carryout and delivery ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's identifies its Northfield restaurant at 15 N Main St and offers carryout or delivery ordering.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 15 N Main St, Northfield
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists this Northfield restaurant and directs visitors to check its current Hours section; its nearby-location listing reports closing at 10:00 PM.

cards.title: A Near-Midnight Convenience Stop
cards.subtitle: 706 N Main Street, Northfield
cards.notes: Check the posted schedule and stop for permitted convenience-store food or household essentials before the 11:59 PM close.
cards.short_summary: A Northfield convenience-store stop open daily until 11:59 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Cumberland Farms lists its 706 N Main Street Northfield store as open daily from 5:00 AM to 11:59 PM.
cards.source_title: Cumberland Farms — 706 N Main Street, Northfield
cards.access_notes: Official posted hours: daily, 5:00 AM–11:59 PM.

cards.title: The 10 PM Grocery Window
cards.subtitle: 63 Plaze Drive, Northfield
cards.notes: Use the supermarket for a planned grocery or snack run; check the day before relying on the later Monday–Saturday closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Northfield grocery store with 10 PM Monday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Tops lists its Northfield store at 63 Plaze Drive, open 7 AM–10 PM Monday through Saturday and 7 AM–9 PM Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official posted hours: Monday–Saturday 7 AM–10 PM; Sunday 7 AM–9 PM.

cards.title: A Midnight Barre Pickup
cards.subtitle: 322 N Main St, Barre
cards.notes: For a later carryout or delivery option outside Northfield, verify the live Hours section before leaving for Barre.
cards.short_summary: A Barre pizza location whose official page shows midnight availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's lists its Barre restaurant at 322 N Main St, and its official nearby-location information reports it open until 12:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 322 N Main St, Barre
cards.access_notes: The official location page directs visitors to its current Hours section; official nearby-location information reports closing at 12:00 AM.

cards.title: Barre Takeout Through 10
cards.subtitle: 276 N Main St, Barre
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s own ordering site to review its hours and place a pickup order, especially if traveling on Friday or Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Barre Chinese restaurant with posted 10 PM daily service and 10:30 PM Friday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Asian Gourmet lists dining and takeout at 276 N Main St, Barre, with 11 AM–10 PM daily hours and 10:30 PM Friday–Saturday hours.
cards.access_notes: Official posted hours say 11 AM–10 PM Monday–Sunday, with Friday–Saturday listed until 10:30 PM; confirm before travel.

cards.title: Dinner in the 1904 Firehouse
cards.subtitle: 8 South Main Street, Barre
cards.notes: Plan a sit-down meal or takeout before the posted 9 PM close, and use the restaurant phone for any same-day questions.
cards.short_summary: A family-oriented Barre restaurant inside a restored 1904 firehouse.
cards.evidence_claim: Ladder 1 Grill identifies its location as a restored 1904 Barre firehouse and posts Tuesday–Saturday hours of 11 AM–9 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official posted hours: Tuesday through Saturday, 11 AM–9 PM.

cards.title: Montpelier Pizza Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: 25 Berlin St, Montpelier
cards.notes: Confirm the live Hours section on the official page, then choose carryout or delivery for an evening order in Montpelier.
cards.short_summary: A Montpelier pizza location with official midnight availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's lists its Montpelier restaurant at 25 Berlin St and reports it open until 12:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 25 Berlin St, Montpelier
cards.access_notes: The official page displays current status and directs visitors to its Hours section; it reports availability until 12:00 AM.

cards.title: A 24-Hour Montpelier Stop
cards.subtitle: 37 Berlin St, Montpelier
cards.notes: Use the official store page to confirm the location, then make a practical food or essentials stop at any time of day.
cards.short_summary: A Montpelier convenience store listed as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Cumberland Farms lists its store at 37 Berlin St, Montpelier, as open 24 hours.

cards.title: A Barre Grocery Run Until 11
cards.subtitle: 456 South Barre Road, Barre
cards.notes: For groceries or prepared-food needs, aim for the Monday–Saturday window and allow time to shop before the listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Barre supermarket open until 11 PM Monday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Hannaford lists its Barre store at 456 South Barre Road as open 7 AM–11 PM Monday through Saturday and until 10 PM Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official posted store hours: 7 AM–11 PM Monday–Saturday; 7 AM–10 PM Sunday.

cards.title: Food Court and Groceries Until 11
cards.subtitle: 168 Ames Drive, Barre
cards.notes: Use the store for groceries or prepared food, and check the official page before travel if a department-specific purchase is needed.
cards.short_summary: A Barre Market 32 open daily until 11 PM with a listed food court.
cards.evidence_claim: Market 32 lists its Barre store at 168 Ames Drive as open 6 AM–11 PM daily and identifies a food court among its amenities.
cards.access_notes: Official posted store hours: 6 AM–11 PM every day. The page lists a food court, sushi, and grocery departments.
